options.title: Focused genetics and metadata review

decision_consequences.resolved: Refine causal/intervention hypothesis; functional validation may still be required.
decision_consequences.unresolved: Keep ambiguity explicit and request a relevant functional test.

limitations: May find no new evidence; does not replace functional perturbation.

options.title: Relevant-context expression-reduction experiment
uncertainty_addressed: functional effect of partial expression reduction

decision_consequences.supportive: Propose independent replication and specificity work.
decision_consequences.useful_effect_excluded: Deprioritize this useful-benefit hypothesis in the tested context.
decision_consequences.uncertain_or_invalid: Preserve reason and agree a focused follow-up with biology.

limitations: Demo assumes the perturbation and assay are feasible; confirm with biology.
Eight paired donors; two methods on the same donors; no independent cohort replication.
Demo thresholds are scientist-reviewable assumptions, not organisational standards.

options.title: Broader perturbation transcriptomics screen

decision_consequences.signature_change: Generate mechanistic hypotheses; functional confirmation remains necessary.
decision_consequences.no_change: May reflect scope or sensitivity; does not alone exclude the functional hypothesis.

limitations: Illustrative effort only; no formal value-of-information optimum.
Less direct for the predefined functional decision than OPT-FUNCTION.
